title: Long-Horizon Policy Value from One Continuous-Time Jump Trajectory with Rare Generator Information
banked_reason: Sound matched subset and explicit brackets leave the promised all-regime focal object open; achieved subfield with paper-score ceiling 6.7 below field floor 7.4; independent validity gate confirms no concrete bounded repair.
gap_reasons: The delivered matching covers both logging experiments for beta >= 1/4 and unknown logging for beta > (sqrt(33)-5)/8, together with fixed-rarity logging separation.
Below the latter threshold, the unknown-logging upper exponent remains smaller than the converse exponent, and the logarithm at equality has no necessity proof.

For fair logging below one quarter, shrinking-rarity precision remains an achievable packet/spatial minimum against a parametric lower floor; the fixed-rarity theorem's delta-dependent constants do not resolve that comparison.
proof_attempt_summary: Four maximality audits and the final multilevel construction produced sound matched regions, fair fixed-rarity precision, and explicit same-class brackets. Unknown-logging matching at and below beta_dagger, endpoint logarithm necessity, and fair shrinking-rarity matching remain open; both cited lemmas passed source attestation. D0.5 halted on the incomplete focal object, and an independent validity gate confirmed a terminal sound subfield result; no Lean formalization was launched.
tldr: For one original trajectory, rare generator information controls long-horizon causal policy precision. Both logging experiments have matched risk \(\asymp\min\{1,N^{-1}\}\) for \(\beta\ge1/4\), including equality. A finite nested multilevel correction extends unknown-logging matching to \((\sqrt{33}-5)/8<\beta<1/4\), with rate \(\min\{1,N^{-1}+N^{-8\beta/(4\beta+1)}\}\), and removes the former critical logarithm at \((\sqrt{265}-13)/24\). At smaller smoothness it gives a sharper explicit two-sided bracket; full matching there and fair shrinking-rarity matching remain open. Fair fixed-rarity precision is parametric at every positive smoothness. V-learning motivates the policy-value question but has a different sampling experiment and model class.
gap: Pointwise infinite-horizon efficiency, nonparametric trajectory Q-function risk and contemporary end-to-end value/occupancy bounds do not yet supply a verified primitive matched scalar precision surface for this holding-plus-density generator. The central unresolved step is coupled operator approximation from complete episodes.
fill: The operator/episode closure question feeds a matched surface with original-record computation and full-path lower testing. It derives every primitive learner bound and allows the inherited quadratic-functional reduction to be proved or refuted.
